Cornell Airbnb Capstone · birds-eye view

Which NYC neighborhoods are priced furthest from fair value, and does that gap shift seasonally?

High-level overview, not per-listing detail. Built from the current GBM fair-price model, calibrated confidence intervals, and real KNN peer-comparison layer, aggregated to the neighborhood level. Short-stay and monthly listings behave differently (price sensitivity, occupancy patterns), toggle between them below. The seasonal price index is illustrative and simulated, standing in for calendar-level pricing data that isn't publicly available.

Neighborhood boundaries: Inside Airbnb (New York City). Basemap: CARTO Positron (© OpenStreetMap contributors, © CARTO). Pricing model, KNN comparables, and seasonality proof-of-concept: Cornell BANA 5160 capstone team, rebuilt tonight on the GBM pipeline (previously Ridge-based). Short-stay and monthly are aggregated separately since their real occupancy patterns and price sensitivity differ meaningfully, not the same underlying distribution split two ways.
